item.title: Walmart CEO Doug McMillon To Retire - The Techee
item.description: He’ll step down on January 31, 2026, and be replaced by John Furner, current CEO of Walmart’s U.S. division.

item.title: Netflix Strikes $83B Takeover Deal For Warner Bros. - The Techee
item.description: Netflix will pay $72bn in cash and stock to acquire Warner Bros. It’ll also assume Warner Bros.' liabilities, pushing up the deal’s value to $82.7bn.

item.title: Tether Makes Unsolicited $1B Bid For Soccer Club Juventus - The Techee
item.description: Tether began buying Juventus shares this year and has built an 11.5% stake. Its takeover offer values Juventus at 1.1 billion euros ($1.3bn).

item.title: SoftBank To Buy Data Center Firm DigitalBridge For $4B - The Techee
item.description: SoftBank will pay $16 in cash per share, totaling $2.9bn. It'll also assume DigitalBridge's liabilities, pushing the deal's value to $4bn.

item.title: The Nigerian Solar Revolution Hiding in Plain Sight - The Techee
item.description: The global renewable energy boom has been much talked about. item.title: Capital One To Buy Fintech Firm Brex For $5B - The Techee
item.description: Capital One will pay $5.15bn in cash and stock for Brex, a provider of corporate credit cards and expense management tools.

item.title: MTN Group To Buy IHS Towers In $6.2B Deal - The Techee
item.description: MTN, already a sizable IHS shareholder, will pay $2.2bn in cash for the 75% stake it doesn't already own.

item.title: Bill Ackman's Pershing Square Files for IPO - The Techee
item.description: A public market listing aligns with Ackman’s strategy of opening his fund to a broader investor base.

item.title: Super Micro Co-Founder Indicted For Smuggling Nvidia Chips - The Techee
item.description: The U.S. government accused the trio of conspiring to sell $2.5 billion worth of high-performance, export-restricted Nvidia chips to companies in China.

item.title: Food Giant Sysco To Buy Restaurant Depot For $29B - The Techee
item.description: Sysco will pay $21.6bn in cash and 91.5 million shares worth roughly $7.5bn at the time of announcement, totaling $29.1bn.
